opportunities.name: Evolved Seeker Return
opportunities.objective: Compare W recast timing on champion hit versus miss.
opportunities.mechanic: W evolves at 100 AP, applies three Plasma stacks and reduces its cooldown by 75% on champion hit. AP items support repeated W and missing-health Plasma; Horizon tests long-range hit follow-up, while R shield scales with AP for a finishing approach.
opportunities.requiredState: Verify W evolve stat threshold and hit an unobstructed champion.
opportunities.failure: Missed W receives no refund and entering with R is unsafe.
opportunities.test: Compare W recast timing on champion hit versus miss; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Evolution cooldown refund is not granted on every non-champion hit.

opportunities.name: Plasma Repeat Window
opportunities.objective: Count attacks, Plasma stacks and E cooldown in one four-second window.
opportunities.mechanic: P attacks stack Plasma and consume four stacks for AP-scaled missing-health magic; E gives four seconds of attack speed and attacks reduce E cooldown. Nashor/Dusk plus Rageblade tests personal on-hit repetition, but Plasma stack events must be logged independently. Q evolution is not assumed for this AP mix.
opportunities.requiredState: Confirm E evolution separately and record starting Plasma/E cooldown.
opportunities.failure: On-hit duplication may not duplicate Plasma and Q lacks enough bonus AD to evolve.
opportunities.test: Count attacks, Plasma stacks and E cooldown in one four-second window; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Repeated item on-hits do not automatically duplicate Plasma stack application.

ruledOut.reason: Q/W/E require separate bonus AD/AP/AS thresholds; one evolved ability does not grant the others.

unknowns: Q maximum conditional damage is unresolved; per-item evolve totals and Dusk/Rageblade Plasma inheritance require live checks.
StatFormula annotations remain symbolic; verify the affected stat basis before numerical comparison.
Unresolved conditional/runtime tooltip tokens prevent a complete numerical model; retained helpers do not establish live behavior.

builds.name: Evolved Seeker Return
builds.summary: Compare W recast timing on champion hit versus miss.
builds.goal: Compare W recast timing on champion hit versus miss.
builds.hypothesis: W evolves at 100 AP, applies three Plasma stacks and reduces its cooldown by 75% on champion hit. AP items support repeated W and missing-health Plasma; Horizon tests long-range hit follow-up, while R shield scales with AP for a finishing approach.
testPlan: Required state: Verify W evolve stat threshold and hit an unobstructed champion.
Compare W recast timing on champion hit versus miss; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Missed W receives no refund and entering with R is unsafe.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Evolution cooldown refund is not granted on every non-champion hit.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Luden's Echo, Horizon Focus, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
